prompt: Use @defer with element reference triggers: on hover(ref), on interaction(ref), on viewport(ref) where trigger element differs from placeholder. Combine multiple triggers with semicolons.

assertions.name: uses_template_ref_variable
assertions.description: Defines a template reference variable (#ref) on the trigger element

assertions.name: uses_element_ref_in_trigger
assertions.description: Passes the ref to trigger: on hover(refName) or on interaction(refName)

assertions.name: combines_triggers
assertions.description: Shows combining multiple triggers with semicolons in a single @defer

assertions.name: trigger_before_defer
assertions.description: Trigger element appears in template ABOVE/BEFORE the @defer block
